description: Opt-in large real-world TOML corpus. 'OfficeIMO.Toml.Benchmarks -- --fetch-corpus' downloads every listed file from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/<owner>/<repo>/<commit>/<path> into a local cache and checks its SHA-256; the files are never committed. '--refresh-corpus' rebuilds each source's 'files' from the trees under its 'roots' at the pinned commit and its 'include' globs ('**' spans folders, '{a,b}' lists alternatives); 'max' samples the sorted matches evenly.
